Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Charles Barkley?

Charles Barkley is 63 years old.

Where was Charles Barkley born?

Charles Barkley was born in Leeds, Alabama.

When was Charles Barkley born?

Charles Barkley was born on February 20, 1963.

How tall is Charles Barkley?

Charles Barkley is 6-6 (198 cm) tall.

How much did Charles Barkley weigh when playing?

Charles Barkley weighed 252 lbs (114 kg) when playing.

Is Charles Barkley in the Hall of Fame?

Charles Barkley was inducted to the Hall of Fame as a Player in 2006 (Full List) .

When was Charles Barkley drafted?

Charles Barkley was drafted by Philadelphia 76ers, 1st round (5th pick, 5th overall), 1984 NBA Draft.

What position did Charles Barkley play?

Power Forward and Small Forward.

When did Charles Barkley retire?

Charles Barkley last played in 2000.

What is Charles Barkley's net worth?

Charles Barkley made at least $43,608,000 playing professional basketball.

How much did Charles Barkley make?

Charles Barkley made $9,000,000 in 2000.

What did Charles Barkley average?

Charles Barkley averaged 22.1 points, 11.7 rebounds, and 3.9 assists per game.

How many rings does Charles Barkley have?

Charles Barkley won 0 championships.

What schools did Charles Barkley attend?

Charles Barkley attended Leeds in Leeds, Alabama and Auburn.

What are Charles Barkley's nicknames?

Sir Charles, The Round Mound of Rebound, The Chuckster, The Chuck Wagon, The Prince of Pizza, The Incredible Bulk, The Leaning Tower of Pizza, Bread Truck, Boy Gorge, Love Boat, Food World, The Crisco Kid, Wide Load from Leeds, Ton of Fun, Goodtime Blimp are nicknames for Charles Barkley.
